title: Chapter 6 and selective chronology — supplement and verification record
status: First manuscript draft for independent review
coverage_policy: This supplement records two newly captured official pages for Chapter 6, two bounded WTO accession-date checks for the chronology, and the chapter drafter's selected rechecks of existing sources. It does not replace the underlying registers, repeat their sources as new acquisitions, or claim a fresh full reading of every cited work. Substantive Board chronology ends July 23, 2026; the September 15 USTR index check is a bounded page-content check.

sources.title: Accessions: China
sources.read_scope: Selected page sections: opening membership sentence and final accession-document timeline entries for the Ministerial decision, protocol, Working Party report and goods/services schedules. The complete lengthy document inventory and linked documents were not read. Relevant final timeline compared with preserved HTML.
locators: Opening: China became the 143rd WTO Member on 11 December 2001
Ministerial Conference/General Council Decision on the Accession: 10/11/2001, WT/L/432
supports: Independent official identification of December 11 membership, distinguished from November 10 approval and October 1 schedule circulation
limitations: Bounded chronology check; no new full reading of the accession Protocol, schedules or negotiations implied.

sources.title: WTO Ministerial Conference approves China’s accession — Press/252
sources.read_scope: Complete substantive release, including date, approval and ratification paragraph, description of adopted documents, statements by Moore and Shi, and closing Working Party/background paragraphs; navigation excluded. Preserved HTML read.
supports: Contemporaneous official account of November 10 approval by consensus and the separate future membership condition; not itself proof of completed membership
limitations: Bounded chronology check; no new full reading of the accession Protocol, schedules or negotiations implied.

EU Decision 2022/529, recitals 1–16 and Articles 1–3, OJ pp. 39–41 / PDF pp. 1–3, text read; article 4 opening incidentally displayed. Remaining operative clauses and annex not re-read for this chapter.

Federal Register p. 48735 / PDF p. 3 fully read as plain extracted text after an overlarge pp. 1–4 layout extraction truncated. Benchmark totals, Section 303 consultations, initiation versus determination and available actions checked; no fresh full-notice reading claimed.

Selected original HTML passage from conclusion before purchase assessment through beginning of manufacturing section: $502.4 billion target, $290.8 billion purchases, 58 percent and baseline interpretation directly checked.
